channel.title: Pruthviraj Desai — Writing
channel.description: Notes, ideas, and things I'm learning, written down by Pruthviraj Desai.

item.title: Starting the Cambridge MBA: what I want to get out of it
item.description: MBA notes #1. At the start of the year at Cambridge Judge, a note on what I'm hoping to learn, what I'm unsure about, and how I'll judge whether it was worth it.

item.title: Engineer, analyst, PM, MBA: why I went to Cambridge
item.description: A materials-science degree, four years in analytics and product at startups, and now an MBA. How the pieces connect, and what I'm hoping the next year adds.

item.title: Vibe coding as a PM: building this site with AI
item.description: I'm not a software engineer, but I built and run this site with an AI coding assistant. What that was like, what it's good at, and what it means for product managers.

item.title: From Product Analyst to APM: what actually changed
item.description: Same company, same product, different job. What changed when I moved from analysing decisions to making them, and what carried over.

item.title: Your event tracking is probably bloated
item.description: Most product analytics setups collect far more events than anyone uses. How to audit your tracking plan, cut the noise, and end up with data people actually trust.
